project_summary: The SmartGlasses project is making progress on core features like subtitle clarity and memory support but faces challenges in balancing discrete UX with visual clarity. The project should focus more on these critical areas to align better with the mission of creating a discreet, context-aware personal assistant.

dimensions.label: Hardware Stack
dimensions.goal: Keep V1 lightweight, discreet, socially acceptable, and dependent on minimal on-glasses compute.
dimensions.progress_summary: The glasses remain light and simple, aligning with the V1 hardware constraints.
dimensions.next_focus: Ensure continued focus on minimal on-glasses processing to maintain weight and social acceptability.

dimensions.label: Software Stack
dimensions.goal: Keep the cognition stack practical, maintainable, and centered on subtitle quality, memory trust, and low-friction assistive behavior.
dimensions.progress_summary: The software is focusing on core features like subtitles and memory support without overcomplicating other areas.
dimensions.next_focus: Continue to refine confidence display formats and subtitle placement rules for V1.

dimensions.label: Wireless Interface
dimensions.goal: Keep the glasses-phone link reliable enough for phone-first processing without making V1 fragile.
dimensions.progress_summary: The wireless interface is being tested and refined to ensure reliability in V1.
dimensions.next_focus: Further test the connection stability between glasses and phone during live use cases.

dimensions.label: Firmware
dimensions.goal: Keep firmware simple, robust, and aligned with touch-first input and lightweight display behavior.
dimensions.progress_summary: The firmware is maintaining a simple design focused on minimal local processing.
dimensions.next_focus: Optimize the firmware to ensure it supports V1 interaction without unnecessary complexity.

dimensions.label: Subtitle System
dimensions.goal: Deliver near-real-time, readable subtitles with trust-preserving visual behavior.
dimensions.progress_summary: The subtitle system is being tested for real-time clarity and stability during live conversation scenarios.
dimensions.next_focus: Refine subtitle placement rules based on confidence levels to ensure readability without distraction.

dimensions.label: Memory System
dimensions.goal: Support fast, trustworthy face/name recall and conversation memory without storing too much low-value information.
dimensions.progress_summary: The memory system is being tested for its ability to store and retrieve relevant memories efficiently.
dimensions.next_focus: Define a caching policy that balances memory utility with privacy concerns and battery efficiency.

dimensions.label: Privacy And Trust
dimensions.goal: Help the wearer understand better without faking understanding, while keeping privacy and consent pressure visible.
dimensions.progress_summary: The project is working on improving trust but needs more work to ensure privacy is not compromised.
dimensions.next_focus: Surface privacy concerns early in the design process to avoid invasive practices.
